visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female creator wearing a tan flat cap and a pleated terracotta-colored top speaks directly to the camera in a bright studio-like indoor setting. (2) She picks up and presents a large, pale pink crystal cluster with both hands, bringing it close to the lens while smiling. (3) The camera cuts to close-up shots of various crystal points, including smoky quartz and clear quartz, resting on a flat white surface. (4) A shot follows of several professional-looking certificates and a logo for 'GEM-A' mounted on a wall. (5) In a classroom setting, a female instructor in a blue dress holds up a large piece of rose quartz while lecturing. (6) A wooden display case filled with dozens of mineral specimens is shown, followed by a macro shot of a faceted purple and green gemstone. (7) The creator is seen peering through a professional gemological microscope, while other students are visible in the blurred background. (8) Close-up shots of hands manipulating small yellow stones and a crystal embedded in a grey matrix follow. (9) An elderly male expert is shown examining a gemstone through a handheld jeweler's loupe under a bright light. (10) The creator also uses a loupe to inspect a pink bead necklace while sitting in the classroom. (11) Various crystal spheres and clusters are shown being held and rotated under bright lighting to reveal internal textures and rutile needles. (12) Hands pull large, translucent quartz clusters out of a cardboard box. (13) A close-up shows a cluster of orange-colored crystalline formations. (14) The creator holds a small shard of clear crystal between her fingers, smiling. (15) Back in the initial studio setting, the creator gestures with her hands towards the camera, smiling as she delivers her closing remarks.

A light rustling sound of handling a mineral cluster occurs as she explains her past purchase. (2) The music continues at a steady 124 BPM as the voice shifts to a more narrative, explanatory tone while describing the discovery of a fake crystal. (3) Soft mechanical clicks and faint tapping sounds of stones being moved on a surface are audible beneath the narration. (4) As the scene changes to a classroom, the ambient noise remains clean but becomes slightly more textured with the resonance of a larger room. (5) High-pitched 'whoosh' and 'pop' sound effects accentuate quick visual transitions. (6) The voice increases in arousal during the final section, encouraging viewers to interact, accompanied by a slight swelling of the BGM volume.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Conflict -> Solution -> Demonstration -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional vlog meant to endorse a professional crystal identification course. It begins with a personal anecdote about being scammed by a synthetic crystal to build relatability and urgency, then transitions into a showcase of the educational environment, resources, and expert guidance available in the course to build authority, finally concluding with an invitation for viewers to inquire for more information.
